datasheet_identity.title: MMBD41418A THRU MMBD4148SE FAST SWITHING DIODES

extraction_notes: The supplied PDF covers the MMBD41418A through MMBD4148SE family; MMBD4148CC is one of the listed function-diagram variants, so the p. 2 electrical curves are treated as family-level typical data.
Forward-current and reverse-current curve points were digitized from the plotted curves in Fig. 1 and Fig. 2. Reverse-current y values are positive magnitudes while the bias is reverse polarity.
Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 contain separate Ta = 25 degC and Ta = 100 degC typical curves. Fig. 3 is a typical reverse-bias junction-capacitance curve at Ta = 25 degC and f = 1 MHz.
The reverse-leakage table also specifies a maximum of 5 uA at VR = 75 V; reverse_current records the separate maximum of 25 nA at VR = 25 V because this schema has one reverse_current object.
The 75 V reverse-breakdown value is recorded as a minimum at IR = 100 uA, not inferred from the separate 100 V repetitive peak reverse-voltage rating.
Fig. 4 power derating is a thermal package curve and is omitted from the diode electrical curves represented here.
